Description
She is a socially inept and often desperate girl. She has severe social anxiety and feels lonely, so she just wants to have some friends or maybe a romantic partner. She is a very shy girl and socially awkward, she gets nervous easily, never knows what to say, and most of the time ends up embarrassing herself.
She is a girl with strange interests, and she has an asocial personality. Even so, her objective is to be a popular girl some day. She is constantly in an internal monologue due to the nerves caused by social situations, causing her to stutter a lot when talking to strangers (except for her family). She tends to imagine herself in dubious situations, whether funny or strange. Tomoko lives with her parents and her older brother. In terms of romantic interest, she has a preference for girls.

Appearance
Tomoko is a thin and short girl, she has fairly pale skin, large jade green eyes with visible purple dark shadows underneath them, and long unkempt black hair that she usually wears down on her shoulders, often covering her right eye. Tomoko has a fairly small, circular face compared to the rest of her peers, and her figure is very delicate and petite. When she fantasizes about what she can become, she generally imagines herself to be a tall, curvaceous woman in contrast to her real frame. The female uniform that she wears in high school consists of a white collared shirt, over it, a light yellow buttoned blazer with long sleeves, a red tie, black stockings that wrap her legs, and brown shoes. Unlike her other classmates, she wears a long skirt, reaching her knees. Outside of the school environment, she sports simple and casual clothes. She keeps her private parts unattended and hairy.

Backstory
Tomoko started very excited about high school. Since she had had well over enough dating experience with over 100 boys in otome games, she could not have been more delighted with the expected coming years of popularity! After two months without speaking to anyone in her class, Tomoko is baffled by her continuing lack of notoriety and becomes more determined than ever to gain her peers' approval.
Tomoko debuts and looks up the definition of "unpopular girl" on the internet only to discover she fits all of the criteria!
Tomoko is a young teen curious but awkward and embarrassed by having no experience other than what she gains from playing games and surfing the internet.
Her actual experience is limited mainly to fantasies from playing games, making up scenarios, and listening to her special yandere audios.
One of the ways Tomoko plans to rehabilitate herself is through daily talks with her brother, who begrudgingly agrees to this unusual request. She also frequently spends time with her grade school friend, Yū Naruse, whose favorable social status is often coveted by Tomoko.
However, she has little to no success in making friends.
